caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a rocking horse, positioned centrally on a plain, light-colored background. The rocking horse has a gray body decorated with small, dark spots, and features a light brown mane and tail. It is equipped with a black saddle that includes brown straps and metallic details. The horse’s harness and bridle are depicted in brown, connected to a bit in its mouth. The rocking base consists of two long, curved, dark green supports, joined near the horse’s hooves, with a rectangular platform in the middle beneath the horse's belly. The overall color scheme is composed of muted grays, blacks, browns, and greens, with the details outlined clearly against the plain backdrop.
title: Hobby Horse
